parameters.name: OrderDetails
parameters.description: The list of orders. Each element in the list contains the details of an order.

sub_parameters.name: ChargeType
sub_parameters.description:
The billable methods of NAS. Valid values:  
- PrePaid: subscription (currently not supported).  
- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go billing method.

sub_parameters.name: FileSystemName
sub_parameters.description:
The file system name.
The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

sub_parameters.name: MountTargetDomain
sub_parameters.description: The mount target name. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

sub_parameters.name: OrderType
sub_parameters.description: The order type. Valid values: BUY.

sub_parameters.name: ProtocolType
sub_parameters.description: The storage protocol. Valid values: nfs.

sub_parameters.name: StorgeType
sub_parameters.description:
The storage type. Valid values:

- capacity: storage-optimized.

- Performance: ultra-fast.
